items.guidance: In the Express app setup, register the route with app.get before any app.use calls for authentication, host checks, or redirects, so the probe on port 3000 is not intercepted. Return res.sendStatus(200) or a small JSON body without touching PostgreSQL or the bull queue. Report the final path so the vendor can set it as the Deployz health check path.

Check where bull queues are created and where their process handlers are registered. Report whether those handlers load in the process started by npm start (the Express server) or only from a separate file or script, and give that file path or script name. Also report which Redis connection setting the bull queues read.
